en: An illustrated winter battle scene showing three cavalry officers on horseback in the foreground, one holding a white flag, approaching fortifications in the distance. Snow covers the ground and low dunes or scrub surround the riders. A soldier lies prone in the snow at left, while other figures stand or walk in the background. A small red flag flies above the distant fort or earthworks. The image has the muted colors and framing typical of early 20th‑century military postcards.
